title: Google DeepMind SVP Koray Kavukcuoglu says Gemini 4 is in the early phase of post-training and hopes it will be released "much earlier" than the end of the year (Laura Bratton/The Information)
summary: Laura Bratton / The Information: Google DeepMind SVP Koray Kavukcuoglu says Gemini 4 is in the early phase of post-training and hopes it will be released “much earlier” than the end of the year — Google is nearing the release of its newest flagship model, Gemini 4, the head of its DeepMind division said Wednesday …
